titre: D'où viennent les visiteurs de Macao

Chine continentale.texte: visitors from the Chinese mainland increased by 11.0% year-on-year to 15,286,203 in the first half year

Hong Kong.texte: Visitors from the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (3,659,900) rose by 0.3% year-on-year

Région de Taïwan.texte: the Taiwan region (575,895) rose by 24.7% year-on-year

Autres pays.texte: International visitors totalled 1,422,448 in the first half year, up by 6.0% year-on-year
